notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (customer support platform). Started with Redwood Hosted API eval (Jan-Feb), good latency for web chat but need deterministic throughput for peak hours. Moving to Dedicated pilot to validate 99th pctl latency, cost targets, and region failover.

Key quotes: "We need predictable token economics during ticket surges" — Head of Platform. "If failover adds <50ms we can tolerate it, but tail latency unacceptable" — SRE lead.

Requirements (high level): vpc connectivity, SSO/SAML, audit logs retention 1y, KMS integration, EU data residency for certain customers. Model preference: prefer open Llama-family 33B variants for majority of traffic, fall back to smaller quantized 7B variant for burst/low-cost routing. Need embeddings for search/retrieval (512-d vector), reranking pipeline for triage.

Engagement so far: hosted API POC -> passed basic evals; now propose Dedicated POC (4 weeks) to test autoscale, canary rollout, and automatic routing/fallback. Pricing conversations ongoing: anchor at $10k/month committed for pilot, scaling to reserved pricing if pass.

poc_success_criteria: 1) 99th pctl latency <= 250ms for typical chat sequences in us-west during synthetic 2k RPS load; 2) cost per 1M tokens below $X target (TBD after baseline run); 3) canary deploy able to roll back within 60s with no lost requests; 4) automated fallback to quantized 7B variant under memory pressure with <50ms overhead; 5) Audit logs delivered to their SIEM within 5 minutes.
canary_plan: Week 1: infra setup + model onboarding in Dedicated. Week 2: Canary stage - route 5% traffic to tuned 33B variant on dedicated pool in us-west, monitor latency/tokens/error rates in Redwood Console. Health checks: p50/p95/p99, KV cache hit rate, memory/eviction. Week 3: increase to 25% if metrics stable; introduce eu-west canary instance for geo-diversity. Week 4: full pilot run at 100% with scheduled load tests and failure injection. Rollback: instant traffic re-route to hosted_api variant and to smaller 7B in-pool model, automated rollback script tested during canary.
fallback_routing_plan: Routing tiers: primary = dedicated 33B us-west; secondary = dedicated quantized 7B us-west (cost-saver + high pressure); tertiary = dedicated 33B eu-west (regional failover); final fallback = Redwood hosted_api 33B variant (if dedicated capacity exhausted). Policies: prefer same-region, prefer non-quantized unless memory>threshold or latency SLO violated. Automatic triggers: memory pressure > 85%, sustained p99 > 350ms for 60s, or capacity shortage event. Logging of fallback events to audit trail with ticket auto-creation (INFRA-2317 style).
pricing_discussion_summary: Initial pilot pricing proposed: $10k/month reserved pilot credit (4-week minimum) + usage overage at hosted API blended rate. Dedicated committed pricing tiers discussed: 3 sizes of GPU pools with predictable token rates. Customer pushing for blended committed rate for first 6 months to smooth GA. Procurement needs SOW with explicit rollback SLAs and incident response RTO/RPO to approve.
